verdict.rationale: Ramp documents in-product AI suggestions drawn from customer data. Ramp Intelligence flags fraud, codes expenses, and scans transactions in real time for anomalies. Every spend request carries a recommended action grounded in your policies, budgets, and funds, and memos and categories are auto-filled (the CLI also exposes memo-suggestions). Missing for 10: in-product analytical insights such as spend trends and forecasting (the docs place these in external assistants via MCP, not inside the product), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI suggestion quality.
